reviews.review:
Repetition. Repetition. Repetition. The game feels like a bunch of people worked on it solo, then just shook everything together with little cohesion. 

 You will spend most of your time exploring newly unlocked area, gathering quests, checking the shop, etc. Once you are good and done and leave the planet or area, they will drop thirty more quests for you to do....in the same area. It never stops. So many meaningless quest with little to no impact on the actual story. Stopped a Murder? Great! Didnt stop a murder? Great! This game moves on past your accomplishments in the blink of an eye. 

 The game also has zero Quality of life additions. You will spend 20 minutes flying to five different planets, seeing the same take-off and landing cutscenes for a simple conversation that ends a quest...or starts the chain all over again. You have a large portion of your spaceship dedicated for video calls. Dedicated for communication. You know, how people communicate in space? Rather than use that, you'll fly one of the most advanced starships around the galaxy...for conversations. I get some need to happen in person, but with vid calls, emails, etc....this is very redundant and time consuming.

 Combat is okay but nothing new to the series. Mostly the same old powers from Mass Effect, very little innovation. There are not many enemy types in the game and outside of different weapons, they all mostly fight the same, leading to the same tactitcs for nearly every fight. Hardly anyone has a shield and armor is everywhere.  Weapons and mods were quite lack luster so for the first time in the series I was a full blown Adept. Throwing enemies around was more fun than shooting them 2,000 times on insanity difficulty. 

Wasted potential. I sure hope whatever new Mass Effect they are working on is not based around this pile of poo.

The original trilogy is epic and its going to be among the best game in gaming history!
Having said that, Andromeda is not the original trilogy, its a very nice game with enjoyable gameplay and lots of combat. 
They did right to take the story entirely different and with no connection with the original trilogy which gave them the freedom to create something new. But the truth is that the story is not so immersive and its a bit repetitive after 20+hours of play.

Overall I would say is a good 7/10 game!

Yes I am officially recommending against this game.

1st of all, this obviously DOES NOT have the charm of the original Mass Effect Trilogy.

2nd of all, I have to login to the EA Launcher before I can even launch the game? Why would I do that when I can play a different game that doesn't require that extra hurdle.

3rd of all, what the hell is even the point of playing this game specifically?

Not worth my time. I uninstalled. I'm done.
Never understood why everyone hated it so much, the launch was a little rocky but at this point its a pretty good game.
Regardless of the unless bugs, I enjoyed the story. Saddens me that there will be no DLCs to complete the game. We shall NOT call this Mass Effect 4!
